Bough an S8 last year. Very very sleek phone and pleasant to hold and a damn shame that its just as fragile as they all are.

Just had the screen on the phone replaced which is a bloody good.opportunity to give a final verdict....

Utter fail. Gimmick. Crap. Horseshit. Duh. Waste of time and money.

For a start same microscratches on the front and back that youd always get zero evidence of the claimed impact protection (it dropped 2 inches from my pocket onto the plastic fuel lever in my car and put a hole in the screen) and a constant grimy sticky film everywhere over the phone that almost takes an electric drill with a polisher on it to remove and instantly returns when you pick up the phone again.

Cut to today and you can feel and see the difference in texture on the new screen (slippery as all fuck no marks on it despite use all day and almost feels like static electricity and giving off that prism effect of light when it reflects) and the rear with the nanoglass still on it (scratched up, sticky, grimy, oily film and dirty great big fingerprints all over) and ive just gone nope not again.

Tl;dr Liquid Nanoglass - Turns your shiny into a grubby oily mess, does literally nothing of what it or the youtube poop actually claims. Dont use it.
